<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/revoked-tokens"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a paginated list of revoked-token records across all users, newest first.
Tokens are stored hashed (SHA-256) - the raw JWT is never persisted or returned, only
a masked prefix/suffix of the hash for identification.

**Requirements**
- The user must be authenticated (logged-in session with `X-WP-Nonce`, or a JWT in
  the header or cookie). Otherwise WordPress answers `401` `rest_forbidden`.
- The user must have the `manage_options` capability (administrator).
